firm_data.firm_description: Tom Anelli & Associates, P.C. is a New York State DWI defense firm. They focus solely on assisting those charged with DWI and DWI-related crimes.
notable_facts: Tom Anelli is certified as a field instructor of Field Sobriety Testing and a NHTSA certified practitioner.
Tom Anelli is the author of the New York Edition of The DUI Book: A Citizen’s Guide to Understanding DWI – DWI Litigation in America.

email.subject: AI for Tom Anelli & Associates, PC - built for firms like yours
